correctness.rationale: Run-alternating K2,2 bijection yields exact rational Laurent generating function. The positive pole and one-dimensional Fourier saddle give K and variance s. Three-dimensional covariance diag(s,s,t) and exactly eight dominant lattice phases yield Cstar. Primitive weighted transfer matrices show exponentially small count below any fixed alpha<1/4; exact total count gives the alpha=1/4 and >1/4 regimes. Seam run length one gives the mirror prefactor. Independent exact position-state enumeration reproduces table n=48, brute-force n<=7, and computed constants; these finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.
